<p class="num-label">01 / About</p>
<p class="section-emoji-head">Sobre mim 👋</p>

```{=html}
<div class="about-card">
  <img class="about-photo round" src="assets/foto-tanise.jpg" alt="Tanise Brandão Bussmann">
  <div>
    <p>I am a <b>civil servant at CADE</b>, Brazil's antitrust authority, in the General Superintendence's conduct unit (CGAA9), where I work on <b>Projeto Cérebro</b> — CADE's initiative to use data science and algorithmic methods to detect cartels and collusion. I am also <b>Adjunct Professor</b> at UNIPAMPA (currently on leave), where I taught macroeconomics, labor economics, and quantitative methods.</p>
    <p>PhD in Economics (PUCRS, 2017) · MSc in Economics (UFMG, 2014) · BSc in Economics (UFRGS, 2011) · Degree in Law (UTP, 2025) · specializations in Competition Defense (FGV) and Public Management.</p>
    <p>Outside of my institutional work, I write <a href="beatlenomics/index.qmd"><b>#beatlenomics</b></a> — a data-essay series that applies the same toolkit (concentration measures, causal inference, market analysis) to The Beatles and Paul McCartney's live career.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
